name: io.github.mxcoppell/pixinsight-connector
title: PixInsight Connector
description: Operate PixInsight from any MCP agent. Community project, not affiliated with Pleiades Astrophoto

environmentVariables.name: PIXINSIGHT_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Path to the PixInsight executable. When unset, the default install location for the OS is used.

environmentVariables.name: PIXINSIGHT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: PixInsight install root, from which the executable and its resources are derived. When unset, the default install location for the OS is used.

environmentVariables.name: PIXINSIGHT_CONNECTOR_PACKS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool packs to load: pack directories and .mjs files (an npm package by the path to its folder). Empty: no packs.

environmentVariables.name: PIXINSIGHT_CONNECTOR_AUTOSTART
environmentVariables.description: 0 stops the connector from starting PixInsight when a tool call finds it not running.

environmentVariables.name: PIXINSIGHT_CONNECTOR_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: The target folder the tools work in (session files in its agentic folder, results in its output folder). When unset, the folder the connector was started in; the set_workspace tool overrides both.

environmentVariables.name: PIXINSIGHT_CONNECTOR_STATE
environmentVariables.description: Where the connector's session files (scratch, bridge, logs) go, resolved against the target folder. When unset, <target>/agentic.

environmentVariables.name: PIXINSIGHT_CONNECTOR_LOG
environmentVariables.description: 0 turns off the per-session call logs in <target>/agentic/logs.
